text: {"label": "Collaboration and Bridging Research With Practice","definition": "Work on interdisciplinary and interprofessional collaboration, community-engaged partnerships, and practitioners conducting or integrating research, including equity in research and closing gaps between researchers and applied practitioners.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centers on working partnerships across professions and between researchers and practitioners, not individual career development, public dissemination and social media, or qualitative research methods."}
